notes.session-state.ts: Original makeMediaResolver is retained in slides/main/media.ts; retintThemedSvg is extracted once to slides/shared/themed-svg.ts and re-exported.
notes.docs/decrypt.ts: Uint8Array/Buffer adapter over the exact shared OOXML module; docs-main now uses docx-encryption.ts re-exports.
notes.slides/shared/themed-svg.ts: retintThemedSvg and SVG_THEME_SLOTS extracted from apps/slides/src/main/session-state.ts; browser and Node share this pure module.
notes.slides/shared/tiff-pixels.ts: TIFF IFD selection, integer/dimension/pixel guards and post-decode validation extracted from apps/slides/src/main/tiff-decode.ts. Browser PNG encoding remains an adapter.
notes.slides/shared/script-fallback.ts: Exact language/glyph decisions and probe patterns extracted from createSystemFontMetrics in apps/slides/src/main/fonts.ts; font lookup is injected.

adaptations: Media, OOXML and script-fallback cores are extracted or copied from the original owning modules; browser/Node host adapters remain private.
Browser and Node share the SVG theme transformation; browser TIFF only adapts byte input and PNG encoding around the original validation/decode core.
Browser metrics and font discovery use the original script fallback decisions with injected catalog/glyph lookup; unavailable preferred faces retain the portable fallback chain.

hostIntegrations.adaptation: Shared Electron decrypt core runs in a bounded child process; HTTP password retry and masked Android prompt are host adapters. Passwords are request-only. Successful upload stores the decrypted parsing copy under its own content hash; client original is unchanged. Both the preview host and standalone XHR upload page share the same password/retry adapter; upload progress remains a transport concern.

Retain TIFF/SVG in the parse-budget-bounded slim archive and invoke the original media resolver with the current slide path. Other media remain streamed. Both server trees and client layout/offline models receive display-ready inline resources.

Reuse the ported sectionPageBox geometry and App docZoomStyle CSS variables. Continuous reading carries padding on one paper wrapper, while source-unit editors keep zero padding. Measurements inherit identical geometry variables. Preserve continuous height and bounded source units; remove remote-only filename spacing.

Mirror .doc-page min-height:var(--page-h,1056px) on the single continuous paper wrapper. Keep virtual source-unit editors at min-height:0 so the minimum is applied once, and allow long content to grow without clipping.
